subject: biology

items.correct: Yes — plants respire all the time; they also photosynthesise in the light.
items.misconception: No, plants only photosynthesise and never respire.
items.why: All living organisms respire to release energy, including plants, day and night.

items.q: Are bacteria a type of animal?
items.correct: No — bacteria are prokaryotes in their own kingdom.
items.misconception: Yes, bacteria are very small animals.
items.random_wrong: Bacteria are a kind of plant.
items.why: Bacteria are single-celled prokaryotes, separate from the animal and plant kingdoms.
Organisms are grouped by features they share, reflecting how closely related they are — not by habitat or size.

items.q: Which is one of the seven life processes (MRS GREN)?
items.misconception: Photosynthesis, which all living things do.
items.why: Movement, respiration, sensitivity, growth, reproduction, excretion and nutrition are common to all living things.

specSource: Pearson Edexcel International GCSE Biology (4BI1) specification; Nature & Variety of Living Organisms
